messages:
maria: uploaded a fresh prototype for the spend dashboard — calling it 'scope swap'. link: https://redwood.design/prototypes/spend-scope-swap :eyes:
aj: looked through it. nice direction. quick things: scope toggle feels discoverable but unclear what stays sticky (time range? token denom?).
sam: big +1 on that — switching org/project currently resets the token denom to USD, which is annoying for token-first workflows. can we persist denom per user? :thinking:
kyle: accessibility nit: the legend chips hit contrast ~3.8:1 on dark mode. we should use token-neutral-300 instead of 200 for BG. also toggle needs an explicit aria-label (screen readers just get "button").
olivia: invoice CTA placement: maria put a global "Download invoice" in the header. prefer it to be contextual: when project is active, show project invoice; when org is active, show org invoice. also show a disabled tooltip for non-admins.
maria: good call on contextual invoices. easy change. quick snippet for aria: ```html
<Toggle aria-label="Scope: organization or project" role="switch" data-testid="scope-toggle" />
```
aj: UI layout debate: option A moves token breakdown to the left rail (always visible) and main chart to the right. option B keeps breakdown above chart as a compact card. A helps with quick comparisons when you scroll projects, B is denser on mobile. thoughts?
sam: prefer A for desktop, but mobile collapsible card for small widths. we need collapse state memory per user (so folks don't re-open every visit).
kyle: for the spend chart: can we add a micro-legend that toggles between "consumption (tokens)" and "cost (USD)" inline? clicking should not re-run backend heavy queries — prefer client-side unit transform where possible.
maria: noted — we'll try client-side transforms with cached per-range rates. also we should surface a tiny CTA: "Show token denom explanation" which expands a tooltip explaining denom, rounding, and what billing unit it maps to.
olivia: copy tweak: instead of "Token breakdown", use "Usage by model & token type" — clearer for support folks. also invoice tooltip: "Invoices generated 24 hours after billing close" (callout for clarity).
billing-bot: heads-up: invoices API returns 404 for non-billing-admins and for months not yet finalized. we should surface that error client-side as "Invoice not available yet" rather than a raw 404.
aj: UX rule: never expose raw error codes in UI. convert common API errors to friendly copy and suggested next action.
kyle: mobile detail: when scope is org and there are many projects, the project list should collapse into a searchable dropdown rather than an infinite vertical list. performance and layout both win.
sam: performance ask: when the scope changes, debounce the chart re-render by 200ms if multiple quick toggles — avoids thrashing analytics.
maria: action items: 1) implement aria-label & contrast fixes (kyle) 2) make invoice CTA contextual + disabled state (olivia) 3) persist token denom per-user (sam) 4) try left-rail breakdown for desktop + collapsible card for mobile (aj) 5) surface friendly invoice errors (aj + billing-bot). I'll update the figma and push a tiny A/B prototype for desktop by EOD.
aj: perfect. once A/B is up we'll do a quick hallway test (3 folks) and iterate. :thumbsup:
